title: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus), Chapter 45
language: Greek (Codex Sinaiticus) / English (King James Version Apocrypha)
source: Codex Sinaiticus folio + transcription (codexsinaiticus.org) + King James Version Apocrypha (1611; 1769 text)
description: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) chapter 45. Manuscript page scan(s) from Codex Sinaiticus hosted by the Codex Sinaiticus Project, with the Project's verbatim transcription of the Greek and the English of King James Version Apocrypha (1611; 1769 text).
introduction:
This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library:

  1. Manuscript scan: The actual folio(s) of Codex Sinaiticus containing this chapter, from the Codex Sinaiticus Project (codexsinaiticus.org). Each section links to the specific folio holding its verses.
  2. Original text: The Codex Sinaiticus Project's verbatim transcription of the folio shown (uncial letters, lunate sigma, nomina sacra preserved).
  3. English translation: King James Version Apocrypha (1611; 1769 text), public domain, retrieved verbatim from ebible.org eng-kjv USFM (KJV with Apocrypha).

Numbering: Verse numbering of Sirach differs between the Greek manuscripts, Rahlfs, and the KJV in many chapters. Compare by content rather than by number.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>και εξηγαγεν εξ αυτου · ανδρα ελεουϲ ˙ ευριϲκοντα χαριν · εν οφθαλμοιϲ παϲηϲ ϲαρκοϲ · ηγαπημενον · απο θυ και ανων · μωϲην · ου το μνημοϲυνον εν ευλογιαιϲ · <sup>2</sup>ωμοιωϲεν αυτον · εν δοξη αγιων · και εμεγαλυνεν αυτον · εν φοβοιϲ εχθρων <sup>3</sup>εν λογοιϲ αυτου · ϲημια κατεπαυϲε · εδοξαϲεν αυτον · κατα προϲωπον βαϲιλεων · ενετιλατο αυτω · προϲ λαον αυτου ˙ και εδειξεν αυτω · τηϲ δοξηϲ αυτου ˙ <sup>4</sup>εν πιϲτι και πραυτητι αυτου · ηγιαϲεν αυτον · εξελεξατο αυτον · εκ παϲηϲ ϲαρκοϲ · <sup>5</sup>ηκουτιϲεν αυτον · τηϲ φωνηϲ αυτου · και ειϲηγαγεν αυτον · ειϲ τον γνοφο · και εδωκεν αυτω κατα προϲωπον · εντολαϲ · νομον · ζωηϲ και επιϲτημηϲ · διδαξαι τον ϊακωβ διαθηκην · και κριματα τον ϊϲλʼ <sup>6</sup>ααρων · ανϋψωϲεν · αγιον ομοιον αυτω ˙ αδελφον αυτου · εκ φυληϲ λευει ˙ <sup>7</sup>εϲτηϲεν αυτον · διαθηκην αιωνοϲ και εδωκεν αυτω · ϊερατειαν λαου · εμακαριϲεν αυτον . εν ευκοϲμια · και περιεζωϲεν αυτον · περιϲτολην δοξηϲ ˙ <sup>8</sup>ενεδυϲεν αυτον · ϲυντελειαν καυχηματοϲ ˙ και εϲτερεωϲεν αυτον εν ϲκευεϲιν ϊϲχυοϲ ˙ περιϲκελη · και ποδηρη · και επωμιδα ˙
translation.text: <sup>1</sup>And he brought out of him a merciful man, which found favour in the sight of all flesh, even Moses, beloved of God and men, whose memorial is blessed. <sup>2</sup>He made him like to the glorious saints, and magnified him, so that his enemies stood in fear of him. <sup>3</sup>By his words he caused the wonders to cease, and he made him glorious in the sight of kings, and gave him a commandment for his people, and shewed him part of his glory. <sup>4</sup>He sanctified him in his faithfuless and meekness, and chose him out of all men. <sup>5</sup>He made him to hear his voice, and brought him into the dark cloud, and gave him commandments before his face, even the law of life and knowledge, that he might teach Jacob his covenants, and Israel his judgments. <sup>6</sup>He exalted Aaron, an holy man like unto him, even his brother, of the tribe of Levi. <sup>7</sup>An everlasting covenant he made with him and gave him the priesthood among the people; he beautified him with comely ornaments, and clothed him with a robe of glory. <sup>8</sup>He put upon him perfect glory; and strengthened him with rich garments, with breeches, with a long robe, and the ephod.

translation.original_text: <sup>9</sup>εκυκλωϲεν αυτον · ροιϲκοιϲ ˙ χρυϲοιϲ κωδεϲιν πλειϲτοιϲ κυκλοθεν · ηχηϲαι φωνην . εν βημαϲιν αυτου ˙ ακουϲτον ποιηϲαι ηχον · εν ναω · ειϲ μνημοϲυνον · ϋϊοιϲ λαου αυτου · <sup>10</sup>ϲτηλη αγια · χρυϲω και ϋακινθω · και πορφυρα · εργων ποικιλτου · λογοι κριϲεωϲ · δηλοιϲ αληθιαϲ · κεκλωϲμενη κοκκω . εργω τεχνιτου · <sup>11</sup>λιθοιϲ πολυτελεϲιν · γλυμματοϲ ϲφραγιδοϲ · ει δεϲι χρυϲιου · εργω λιθουργου ˙ ειϲ μνημοϲυνηον · εν γραφη κεκολαμμενη · κατα αριθμον . φυλαϲϲων ϊϲλʼ · <sup>12</sup>ϲτεφανον χρυϲουν . επανω κιδαρεωϲ ˙ εκτυπωμα · ϲφραγιδοϲ αγιαϲματοϲ · καυχημα τιμηϲ · εργον ϊϲχυοϲ · επιθυμηματα οφθαλμων . κοϲμουμενα <sup>13</sup>ωραια προ αυτου · γεγονεν τοιαυτα · εωϲ αιωνοϲ · ουκ ενεδυϲατο αλλογενηϲ · πλην · των υϊων αυτου μονον ˙ και τα εκγονα αυτου δια παντοϲ ˙ <sup>14</sup>θυϲιαι αυτων . ολοκαρπωθηϲονται ˙ καθ ημεραν · ενδελεχωϲ διϲ . <sup>15</sup>επληρωϲεν μωϋϲηϲ · ταϲ χιραϲ και εχριϲεν αυτον · εν ελαιω αγιω · εγενηθη αυτω . ειϲ διαθηκην αιωνοϲ · και τω ϲπερματι αυτου . εν ημεραιϲ ουνου · λιτουργειν αυτω αμα · και ϊερατευειν ˙ και ευλογειν τον λαον αυτου · εν τω ονοματι <sup>16</sup>εξελεξαντο αυτον · απο παντοϲ ζωντοϲ ˙ προϲαγαγειν · καρπωμα κω · θυμιαμα και ευωδιαν · ειϲ μνημοϲυνον · εξιλαϲκεϲθαι · περι του λαου
translation.text: <sup>9</sup>And he compassed him with pomegranates, and with many golden bells round about, that as he went there might be a sound, and a noise made that might be heard in the temple, for a memorial to the children of his people; <sup>10</sup>With an holy garment, with gold, and blue silk, and purple, the work of the embroiderer, with a breastplate of judgment, and with Urim and Thummim; <sup>11</sup>With twisted scarlet, the work of the cunning workman, with precious stones graven like seals, and set in gold, the work of the jeweller, with a writing engraved for a memorial, after the number of the tribes of Israel. <sup>12</sup>He set a crown of gold upon the mitre, wherein was engraved Holiness, an ornament of honour, a costly work, the desires of the eyes, goodly and beautiful. <sup>13</sup>Before him there were none such, neither did ever any stranger put them on, but only his children and his children’s children perpetually. <sup>14</sup>Their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually. <sup>15</sup>Moses consecrated him, and anointed him with holy oil: this was appointed unto him by an everlasting covenant, and to his seed, so long as the heavens should remain, that they should minister unto him, and execute the office of the priesthood, and bless the people in his name. <sup>16</sup>He chose him out of all men living to offer sacrifices to the Lord, incense, and a sweet savour, for a memorial, to make reconciliation for his people.

translation.original_text: <sup>17</sup>εδωκεν αυτω . εντολαϲ αυτου · εξουϲιαν · εν διαθηκαιϲ κριματω · διδαξαι τον ϊακωβ · τα μαρτυρια και εν νομω αυτου . φωνηϲαι ϊϲλʼ · <sup>18</sup>επιϲυνεϲτηϲαν αυτω αλλοτριοι · και εζηλωϲαν αυτον εν τη ερημω · ανδρεϲ · οι περι δαθαν και αβειρων · και η ϲυναγωγη κορε . εν θυμω και οργη ˙ <sup>19</sup>ειδεν κϲ · και ουκ ευδοκηϲεν · και ϲυνετελεϲθηϲαν · εν θυμω οργηϲ εποιηϲεν εν αυτοιϲ · τερατα · καταναλωϲαι · εν πυρι φλογοϲ αυτου · <sup>20</sup>και προϲεθηκεν ααρων δοξαν · και εδωκεν αυτω · κληρονομιαν · απαρχαϲ πρωτογενηματων . εμεριϲεν αυτω ˙ αρτον πρωτον γενηματοϲ ητοιμαϲεν εν πληϲμονη · <sup>21</sup>και γαρ θυϲιαϲ κυ · φαγονται · αϲ εδωκεν αυτω . και τω ϲπερματι αυτου · <sup>22</sup>πλην εν γη λαου . ου κληρονομηϲει · και μεριϲ · ουκ εϲτιν αυτω εν λαω · αυτοϲ γαρ μεριϲ ϲου κληρονομια · <sup>23</sup>και φινεεϲ υϊοϲ ελεαζαρ . τριτοϲ ειϲ δοξαν · εν τω ζηλωϲαι αυτον . εν φοβω κυ · και ϲτηϲαι αυτον · εν τροπη λαου · εν αγαθοτητι προθυμιαϲ · ψυχηϲ αυτου ˙ και εξειλαϲατο περι του ϊϲλʼ · <sup>24</sup>δια τουτο . εϲταθη αυτω διαθηκη ειρηνηϲ προϲτατην αγιων · και λαω αυτου · ϊνα αυτω . η και τω ϲπερματι αυτου · ϊερωϲυνηϲ μεγαλειον . ειϲ τουϲ αιωναϲ
translation.text: <sup>17</sup>He gave unto him his commandments, and authority in the statutes of judgments, that he should teach Jacob the testimonies, and inform Israel in his laws. <sup>18</sup>Strangers conspired together against him, and maligned him in the wilderness, even the men that were of Dathan’s and Abiron’s side, and the congregation of Core, with fury and wrath. <sup>19</sup>This the Lord saw, and it displeased him, and in his wrathful indignation were they consumed: he did wonders upon them, to consume them with the fiery flame. <sup>20</sup>But he made Aaron more honourable, and gave him an heritage, and divided unto him the firstfruits of the increase; especially he prepared bread in abundance: <sup>21</sup>For they eat of the sacrifices of the Lord, which he gave unto him and his seed. <sup>22</sup>Howbeit in the land of the people he had no inheritance, neither had he any portion among the people: for the Lord himself is his portion and inheritance. <sup>23</sup>The third in glory is Phinees the son of Eleazar, because he had zeal in the fear of the Lord, and stood up with good courage of heart: when the people were turned back, and made reconciliation for Israel. <sup>24</sup>Therefore was there a covenant of peace made with him, that he should be the chief of the sanctuary and of his people, and that he and his posterity should have the dignity of the priesthood for ever:

translation.original_text: <sup>25</sup>και διαθηκην δαδ ϋιων εκ φυληϲ ιουδα · κληρονομια βαϲιλεωϲ · ϋϊου εξ υϊου μονου κληρονομια αυτων · και τω ϲπερματι αυτου · <sup>26</sup>δοιη ϋμιν ϲοφιαν . εν καρδια υμων · κρινειν τον λαον αυτου εν δικαιοϲυνη · ϊνα μη αφανιϲθη τα αγαθα αυτων · και την δοξαν αυτων . ειϲ γενεαν αυτων ˙
translation.text: <sup>25</sup>According to the covenant made with David son of Jesse, of the tribe of Juda, that the inheritance of the king should be to his posterity alone: so the inheritance of Aaron should also be unto his seed. <sup>26</sup>God give you wisdom in your heart to judge his people in righteousness, that their good things be not abolished, and that their glory may endure for ever.
